message.content:
**Ryan Giggs** – the former Manchester United midfielder holds the Premier League record for the most assists in the competition’s history, with **162 assists** across 632 appearances from 1990‑2014.  

> *Key points*  
> • All‑time assist leader (Premier League only).  
> • Played 23 seasons for Manchester United, winning 13 league titles.  
> • His 162 assists include 20 in a single season (2009‑10), the record for most assists in one Premier League campaign.  

If you’re looking for the current season’s top assist provider, let me know the season (e.g., 2023‑24) and I can fetch the latest stats.
